Before you connect

You need Mythforge: Beyond the Horizon installed. A vanilla client or a different modpack will not have the mods required to join.

Use the matching pack version when joining. Check release announcements before updating.

How to join

  1. Install the Mythforge pack using the Getting Started guide.
  2. Launch the matching version and open Multiplayer.
  3. Select Add Server, enter play.mythforge.win, and join.

Good to know

Server questions, answered.

Can I join with vanilla Minecraft?

No. Install Mythforge and use the same pack version as the server.

Which version should I use?

The required version is 1.2.4. Install the latest published release; the server follows the latest version.

What happens if I cannot connect?

Verify the server address and modpack version, restart the game, and check maintenance announcements. See troubleshooting for more help.

Can I support the server?

The supporter page explains the proposed rewards and playtime philosophy. Packages and prices are not finalized.

Built for the long journey

Help keep the forge lit.

Support goes toward keeping a shared world running. Many functional conveniences are intended to have playtime unlock paths as well.
